title: 007-Letter from Halima and Ahmed (Halima ve Ahmed'den Mektup)

sentences.englishText: Halima and Ahmed are visiting Washington D.C. with their friend Tom and writing to their aunt.
sentences.turkishText: Halima ve Ahmed arkadaşları Tom ile Washington D.C.'yi ziyaret ediyor ve halalarına mektup yazıyorlar.

sentences.englishText: They have visited historical sites like the Lincoln Memorial and the White House already.
sentences.turkishText: Lincoln Anıtı ve Beyaz Saray gibi tarihi yerleri zaten ziyaret ettiler.

sentences.englishText: They were unable to enter the Air and Space Museum because they arrived after closing time.
sentences.turkishText: Kapandıktan sonra vardıkları için Hava ve Uzay Müzesi'ne giremediler.

enrichment.summary: Halima and Ahmed are visiting Washington D.C. with their friend Tom and writing to their aunt. They have visited historical sites like the Lincoln Memorial and the White House already.
